content: अनुपतनम्, -पातः .²1 Falling upon, alighting upon in succession. .²2 Following, going after, pursuit; उपवनपवनानुपातदक्षैः <ls>Śi. 7. 27</ls>. .²3 Going or proceeding in order or as a consequence. .²4 [अनुरूपः त्रैराशिकेन पातः] Proportion. .²5 Rule of three. .²6 A degree of latitude, opposite to one given. .{@-तम्@} {%ind.%} (regarded as ending in {%namul%} from पत्) Following in succession, going after; लतानुपातं कुसुमान्यगृह्णात् <ls>Bk. 2. 11</ls> (लतां लतामनुपात्य going to creeper after creeper, or after bending the creepers.)
